description: ADO-VIEW Find(criteria, SkipRows, SearchDirection, Start) on a client static read-only Recordset of SELECT ID, L, S FROM T ORDER BY ID: from MoveFirst Find "L = 20" then twice more with SkipRows 1; from MoveLast Find "L = 20" backward (SkipRows 0, then 1); Start = 1 (adBookmarkFirst), 2 (adBookmarkLast) and 0 (adBookmarkCurrent) with Find "ID = 2"; Find "L IS NULL", "S LIKE 'a*'", "S = 'it''s'", Find with SkipRows -1, with criteria "" and Null, and a forward Find issued at EOF. After each read EOF, BOF, AbsolutePosition and the current ID and the Errors. Asks the cursor position after a match and after no match for each direction, skip and start.
retentionNote: Designed r-ado-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
